title: action.confirm body v1
description: Confirmation handshake for destructive+ tools. kind=request: act -> voice/HUD, spoken as a question. kind=answer: whoever heard the user (act itself from a scoped transcript window, or jv CLI) -> act. Timeout (15s) = denied. Envelope conf = 1.0.

summary.description: request only: the question to speak ('Delete 3 files from Downloads — yes or no?').

window_s.description: request only: how long the answer window stays open.

answered_by.description: answer only: where the answer came from.
